description: Bare metal to production ready in mins; your own fly server on your VPS.

summary.one_liner: Sidekick is a Go CLI that sets up an Ubuntu VPS with Docker, Traefik and SOPS, then deploys Dockerfile-based apps to it, aiming to act like a self-hosted fly.io.
summary.what_it_does: Sidekick runs a one-time setup on a VPS (creates a sidekick user, disables root login, installs Docker, sops and age, and sets up Traefik with SSL certs). The `sidekick launch` command builds a local Dockerfile image for Linux, transfers it to the VPS, encrypts an optional .env file with sops, and runs the container via docker compose behind Traefik. `sidekick deploy` redeploys with zero downtime and re-encrypts the env file only when its checksum changes. `sidekick deploy preview` creates preview apps tagged by git commit hash, which requires a clean git tree. Domains can be connected directly or served under sslip.io for testing.
use_cases: Host side projects on a cheap VPS
Deploy a Dockerfile app to a VPS without Kubernetes
Set up a fresh Ubuntu VPS for Docker hosting
Spin up preview deployments per git commit
Manage encrypted env secrets for a self-hosted app
Run multiple apps on one VPS behind Traefik
how_to_run: sidekick init  (enter VPS IP address and email for SSL certs)
sidekick launch  (run in app folder containing a Dockerfile)
sidekick deploy preview  (requires a clean git tree)
notable: Brings a fly.io-style deploy workflow to a plain VPS with one setup command
Zero-config SSL certificates, or sslip.io domains out of the box
Built-in SOPS integration for encrypting and injecting env secrets at runtime
Preview environments tied to git commit hashes
caveats: Requires Homebrew (brew) on the local machine, since it uses brew to install sops
Targets Ubuntu LTS VPS hosts with SSH key login
Roadmap items such as firewall setup, multi-VPS management, databases and compose support are not yet built; some features may move to a paid version
keywords: deploy app to my own server
